styleMenu.Name: Default Icon Style
styleMenu.Label: Default Icon Style
styleMenu.Hint: Shape, colors and font of new icons, and the size of new map notes. Each note can change its own style.

matchingMenu.Name: Name Matching
matchingMenu.Label: Name Matching
matchingMenu.Hint: Which journal names get an automatic icon, and which part of the name becomes the icon text.

rebuildMenu.Name: Rebuild Icons
rebuildMenu.Label: Rebuild Icons
rebuildMenu.Hint: Creates the icon images of all map notes with an automatic icon again, in every scene. Use it after deleting the images, moving the upload folder or changing the default style.

folderIcon.Name: Icons from Folders
folderIcon.Hint: A new map note whose journal entry is in a folder named like a stock icon (for example "Village" or "Cave") gets that icon. Automatic icons from the name win.

autoPageImage.Name: Icons from Image Pages
autoPageImage.Hint: A new map note without an automatic icon uses the image of its image page, or of the journal entry's first image page, as its icon.

autoClose.Name: Quick Add Mode
autoClose.Hint: When a new map note gets its icon from this module, it is created right away without showing the map note window.

uploadPath.Name: Upload Folder
uploadPath.Hint: Folder in your user data where the icon images are saved. Don't delete the images: map notes still use them.

autoIcon.Name: Automatic Icon
autoIcon.Hint: Replaces the icon chosen above with a generated icon showing the text below.

iconText.Name: Icon Text
iconText.Hint: Up to 3 characters are easy to read, 4 may fit.

fontFamily.Name: Font
fontFamily.Hint: Name of a font from fonts.google.com, for example "Roboto Slab". Leave empty for the default font.
fontFamily.NotFound: This font couldn't be loaded from Google Fonts. The icon uses the default font.

fontStyle.Name: Font Style
fontStyle.Hint: If the font has no bold or italic style, the regular style is used.

iconFontSize.Name: Text Size
iconFontSize.Hint: Size of the text inside the icon. The icon is 512 units wide.

preview.Name: Preview
preview.Hint: The tint chosen above isn't shown here.

sampleText.Name: Sample Text
sampleText.MatchingHint: A journal name to test the patterns with.

iconScale.Name: Icon Size
iconScale.Hint: Size of new map notes in grid squares (1 = one square).

fontSize.Name: Label Font Size
fontSize.Hint: Font size of the label of new map notes.

Matching.Title: Name Matching
Matching.Intro: The patterns are tried from top to bottom; the first one that matches the start of the name sets the icon text.

Custom.Name: Custom Pattern
Custom.Hint: A regular expression, without the surrounding slashes. Start it with ^ to match the start of the name. The last capture group becomes the icon text. Leave empty to turn it off.

Matching.NoMatch: No match: this name gets no automatic icon.

Rebuild.Title: Rebuild Icons
Rebuild.Intro: Creates the icon images of all map notes with an automatic icon again, in every scene of this world. This can take a while with many notes.

Keep.Name: Keep each note's style
Keep.Hint: Recreates missing images, for example after moving or deleting the upload folder.

Defaults.Name: Use the default style
Defaults.Hint: Replaces each note's style and size with the current defaults. The icon text is kept.

Rebuild.Done: Rebuilt the icons of {count} map notes.
Rebuild.Failed: {failed} of {total} map note icons couldn't be rebuilt. See the console (F12) for details.
Rebuild.None: No map notes with an automatic icon found.

Notifications.UploadFailed: Nik's Journal Icon Numbers: the icon image couldn't be saved. Check the upload folder setting and your file permissions.
Notifications.LegacyActive: Nik's Journal Icon Numbers is turned off while "Automatic Journal Icon Numbers" is active. Deactivate one of the two modules.
Notifications.Migrated: Nik's Journal Icon Numbers: copied the settings and the icons of {notes} map notes from Automatic Journal Icon Numbers.
Notifications.FilesMigrating: Nik's Journal Icon Numbers: moving map note icons to {folder}…
Notifications.FilesMigrated: Nik's Journal Icon Numbers: moved the icons of {count} map notes to {folder}. The old files are still in their old folder.
Notifications.FilesMigratedFailed: Nik's Journal Icon Numbers: {failed} of {total} map note icons couldn't be moved. Details in the console (F12). Rebuild Icons can create them again for notes with an automatic icon.
Notifications.FontUnavailable: Nik's Journal Icon Numbers: Google Fonts can't be reached, so new icons use the default font for now. Rebuild Icons adds the right font once it's reachable again.
Notifications.WaitingForGM: Nik's Journal Icon Numbers: this note's icon will be created when a GM connects.
Notifications.FilesLockedPacks: Nik's Journal Icon Numbers: these locked compendiums still use icons from the old folder: {packs}. Keep the old folder, or unlock them and follow the steps in the README.
